reconciliation.roi_definition: sum(net_pnl) / sum(quoted ask price); slippage and fees are inside net_pnl, not in the denominator

concentration.effective_independent_units_note: 7 theses sit on 5 player-games in 2 games; points, PRA and threes of one player move together, so the number of independent outcomes is closer to 5 player-games, and the game is the cluster

evidence_gaps.board_archive_clock: capture-branch commit time of the board each row used (independent clock): 192-211 s after observation; 0 of 7 boards were committed AFTER the row was decided

computation_lag_s_replay.meaning: seconds between the information cut-off (as_of) and the moment the replay row was actually computed; the price may no longer have been available then

evidence_gaps.contemporaneous_computation: 1 of 7 selected rows were computed at the time (decision_mode contemporaneous); 6 are as-of replays rebuilt from the capture archive after the fact
evidence_gaps.fills: no order exists for any of the rows; none of the prices is a recorded fill
evidence_gaps.multi_horizon_selection: each thesis is taken at the EARLIEST horizon that traded it; the alternative horizons are alternative runs with separately reset exposure caps
